title: Can We Design PeaceTech Without Do No Harm and Community Development?
content:
At The PeaceTech We Want Summit 2026, peacebuilders and technologists explored how Do No Harm, community development and local ownership should shape the design of PeaceTech, and whether existing human-centred approaches go far enough.

The post Can We Design PeaceTech Without Do No Harm and Community Development? first appeared on Open Knowledge Blog.
